verdict.rationale: Twenty offers a no-code Zapier connector (5,000+ apps) and a developer platform for building/publishing 'apps' with custom UI and logic, plus workflow triggers that can call Slack via HTTP webhooks — but there is no evidence of a curated app marketplace with one-click prebuilt integrations specifically for Slack, support desk, marketing, or data warehouse tools as the story describes. missing for 10: dedicated marketplace listing prebuilt Slack/support-desk/marketing/data-warehouse connectors, one-click install flow, and independent confirmation of such integrations working out of the box.
